sentences.translation: Three years ago, my fourteen-year-old son had a car accident. I donated my child's kidney to a Palestinian girl suffering from uremia, expressing my wish for peaceful coexistence between the two nations. sentences.text: 但这一切都没有用，我们的家园仍在冤冤相报的泥潭中越陷越深。
sentences.translation: But all this is of no use, our homeland is still sinking deeper into the quagmire of tit-for-tat.
sentences.explanation: The phrase '冤冤相报' means 'tit-for-tat', indicating a cycle of revenge or retaliation. The structure '越陷越深' is a pattern used to emphasize the deepening of a negative situation.

sentences.translation: Despair turned me from a pacifist into an extremist, and perhaps also because of my substantial donations to the organization, I was able to enter the core of the Adventists.

sentences.translation: The Adventists made an unforgivable betrayal to the organization by taking advantage of this condition.
